generator_cmd: qemu-img convert -f raw -O vpc -o subformat=fixed,force_size=on zero1.img vhdfix.vhd (fixed VHD footer appended; primary GPT zeroed -> backup sits at the last LBA BEFORE the footer)
oracle_cmd: qemu-img convert -f vpc -O raw vhdfix.vhd vhdfix.vhd.raw && sfdisk --json vhdfix.vhd.raw | jq '[.partitiontable.partitions[].start]'
